slides.description: Write the slides in order. There must be exactly brief.slides of them.

layout.description: The layout code: one of cover, agenda, section, bullets, figure, table, comparison, closing.

topic.description: What this slide covers, in one English sentence (a note for the writer; not shown on the slide).

parts.description: The addresses of the text parts this slide rests on (report.sections[].address). For a section cut into several pieces, one piece is enough (the program adds all its pieces). A table or figure slide: one or more of that table's or figure's text_parts. The cover: the one text part with the document's title; the agenda and section slides: an empty list.

table.description: The address of the table on a table slide (report.tables[].address). An empty string for every other layout.

rows.description: The numbers of the table rows to show. The header rows (row 1 and the rows right under it with no number) are always shown. Empty shows every row. An empty list when it is not a table slide.

figure.description: The address of the figure on a figure slide (report.figures[].address). An empty string for every other layout.
